title: Shelter In Place
description: Plain-text reference: immediate actions, then specific steps for tornadoes, hurricanes, storms, chemical releases (sealing a room), and active threats. Covers communication, supplies, duration, ending shelter, common mistakes, and the needs of children, elders, pets, and medical patients.
shortDescription: First-minute actions by threat type, supplies, and when to come out
